prompts.text: I have pretended to be sick to escape a date or night out.
I have typed a risky text, stared at it, and sent it anyway.
I have checked an ex's profile and denied it when asked.
I have left a party without saying goodbye to anyone.
I have ignored a red flag because the story was entertaining.
I have sent a second message before getting a reply to the first.
I have given a fake name to avoid a longer conversation.
I have ordered something I could not pronounce with confidence.
I have danced like nobody was watching while many people were watching.
I have said one last drink and meant at least two more.
I have changed an outfit because someone I liked might be there.
I have screenshotted a message to ask friends what it meant.
I have listened to my own voicemail greeting and decided it sounded strange.
I have taken the long way around to avoid an awkward hello.
I have invented a cover story for an extremely ordinary plan.
I have set an alarm for a conversation I did not want to forget.
Who in this room would flirt their way out of a parking ticket?
Who in this room would turn a quiet night into a story?
Who in this room would accidentally become friends with an ex's friends?
Who in this room would make a suspicious story sound completely reasonable?
